source_text: Itaque requirenda tempora praedictae et futurae nativitatis Christi, et passionis ejus, et exterminii civitatis Hierusalem, id est, vastationis ejus. Dicit enim Daniel et civitatem sanctam et sanctum exterminari cum duce venturo, et destrui pinnaculum usque ad interitum. Venturi itaque Christi ducis sunt tempora requirenda, quae investigabimus in Daniele: quibus computatis, probabimus venisse cum, etiam ex temporibus praescriptis, et ex signis competentibus, et ex operationibus ejus: quae probamus ex consequentibus quae post adventum ejus futura adnuntiabantur, ut tam adimpleta omnia quam prospecta credamus. Sic igitur de eo Daniel praedicavit, ut et quando et quo in tempore gentes esset liberaturus, ostenderet, et quoniam post passionem Christi ista civitas exterminari haberet. Dicit enim sic: In primo anno sub Dario filio Assueri ex semine Medorum, qui regnavit super regnum Chaldaeorum, ego Daniel intellexi in libris numerum annorum. Et adhuc me loquente in oratione, ecce vir Gabriel, quem vidi in visione in principio, volans, et tetigit me, quasi hora sacrificii vespertini, et intelligere fecit me, et locutus est mecum, et dixit: «Daniel, nunc exivi imbuere te intelligentia, in principio obsecrationis tuae exivit sermo. Et ego veni ut annuntiem tibi, quia vir desideriorum tu es, et cogita in verbo, et intellige in visione.» Septuaginta hebdomadae breviatae sunt super plebem tuam, et super civitatem sanctam, quoadusque inveteretur delictum, et signentur peccata, et exorentur injustitiae, et inducatur justitia aeterna, ut et signetur visio et prophetes, et ut ungatur Sanctus sanctorum. Et scies, et perspicies et intelliges a profectione sermonis, integrando et reaedificando Hierusalem usque ad Christum ducem, hebdomadas septem et dimidiam, et septuaginta duas et dimidiam: et convertet, et aedificabitur in laetitiam, et convallationem, et innovabuntur tempora: et post hebdomadas has septuaginta duas, et exterminabitur unctio, et non erit: et civitatem et sanctum exterminabit cum duce adveniente, et concidentur quomodo in cataclysmo usque ad finem belli, quod concidetur usque ad interitum. Et confirmabit testamentum in multis.
thought_title: Christ's Birth, Passion, and Jerusalem's Destruction
pass_a_gloss: Therefore, the times of the predicted and future birth of Christ, and of His passion, and of the destruction of the city of Jerusalem, that is, of its devastation, are to be sought. For Daniel says that the holy city and the holy one are to be destroyed with the coming leader, and the pinnacle is to be destroyed until the end. Therefore, the times of the coming leader Christ are to be sought, which we will investigate in Daniel: when these have been calculated, we will prove that He came, both from the prescribed times, and from the suitable signs, and from His works: which we prove from the subsequent things that were announced as going to happen after His advent, so that we may believe that all things have been fulfilled as well as foreseen. Thus, therefore, Daniel prophesied about Him, that He would show both when and at what time He would be liberating the nations, and that after the passion of Christ this city would be destroyed. For he says thus: In the first year under Darius the son of Ahasuerus of the seed of the Medes, who reigned over the kingdom of the Chaldeans, I, Daniel, understood in the books the number of years. And while I was still speaking in prayer, behold, the man Gabriel, whom I saw in the vision at the beginning, flying, and he touched me, as if at the hour of the evening sacrifice, and made me understand, and spoke with me, and said: 'Daniel, now I have come to impart understanding to you, at the beginning of your supplication the word went out. And I have come to announce to you, because you are a man of desires, and consider the word, and understand the vision.' Seventy weeks have been shortened over your people, and over the holy city, until the sin is aged, and the sins are sealed, and the injustices are expiated, and eternal justice is introduced, so that the vision and the prophet may be sealed, and the Holy of Holies may be anointed. And you will know, and perceive, and understand from the going out of the word, restoring and rebuilding Jerusalem until Christ the leader, seven and a half weeks, and sixty-two and a half weeks: and it will be converted, and built in joy, and a wall, and the times will be renewed: and after these sixty-two weeks, the anointing will be destroyed, and will not be: and the city and the holy one will be destroyed with the coming leader, and they will be cut off as in a flood until the end of the war, which is cut off until the end. And He will confirm the covenant in many.

bible_refs.note: seventy weeks, holy city, anointing, destruction

pass_b_english: Therefore we must pin down the times of Christ's predicted and future birth, his passion, and the extermination of the city of Jerusalem—that is, its devastation. Daniel says both the holy city and the holy one will be destroyed when the coming leader arrives, and the pinnacle will be destroyed until the end (Daniel 9:24-27). So we must investigate the times of the coming leader Christ in Daniel; once we calculate them, we will prove he came—not only from the prescribed times, but from the fitting signs and from his works. We prove this from the events announced to happen after his advent, so we may believe all things were fulfilled just as they were foreseen.

Thus Daniel prophesied about him to show both when and at what time he would liberate the nations, and that this city would be destroyed after Christ's passion. Here is what he says: In the first year of Darius son of Ahasuerus, of Median stock, who ruled the Chaldean kingdom, I, Daniel, understood from the books the number of years. While I was still praying, the man Gabriel—the one I had seen in the vision at the beginning—came flying and touched me, about the time of the evening sacrifice. He gave me understanding, spoke with me, and said: "Daniel, I have now come to give you insight. At the start of your plea the word went out, and I have come to tell you, because you are a man of desires. Consider the word and understand the vision."

Seventy weeks have been decreed for your people and for the holy city, until sin grows old, sins are sealed up, injustices are atoned for, and everlasting righteousness is brought in, so that vision and prophet may be sealed and the Holy of Holies anointed (Daniel 9:24-27). You will know, discern, and understand from the issuing of the word: from restoring and rebuilding Jerusalem until Christ the leader comes, seven and a half weeks and sixty-two and a half weeks. It will be restored and built with joy, and a wall, and the times will be renewed. After those sixty-two weeks, the anointing will be cut off and will be no more; the city and the holy place will be destroyed when the leader comes, and they will be swept away as in a flood until the end of the war, which is decreed to the very end. And he will confirm the covenant with many (Daniel 9:24-27).
